Incumbent Senator [[Todd Young]] won a second term.{{Cite web |date=November 8, 2022 |title=2022 US Senate Election Results: Live Map |url=https://abcnews.go.com/Elections/2022-us-senate-election-results-live-map/ |access-date=2022-11-09 |website=ABC News |language=en}} Young announced on March 2, 2021, that he would be running for a second term.{{cite web|date=March 2, 2021|title='I'm running': Todd Young to seek re-election to US Senate|url=https://www.wane.com/news/your-local-election-hq/im-running-todd-young-to-seek-re-election-to-us-senate/|url-status=live|access-date=March 2, 2021|website=[[WANE-TV]]|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210419214118/https://www.wane.com/news/your-local-election-hq/im-running-todd-young-to-seek-re-election-to-us-senate/ |archive-date=2021-04-19 }} He was first elected to the Senate in [[2016 United States Senate election in Indiana|2016]] with 52.1% of the vote, succeeding retiring fellow Republican [[Dan Coats]]. [[Hammond, Indiana|Hammond]] Mayor [[Thomas McDermott Jr.]] ran for the Democratic nomination. Both ran unopposed and won their respective primaries on May 3, 2022. In [[2016 United States Senate election in Indiana|2016]], Young was initially perceived as the underdog when Former Senator Evan Bayh was chosen to replace Representative Baron Hill.{{Cite web |last=says |first=Howard |date=2016-09-19 |title=With Evan Bayh's surprise entry, Indiana's Senate race has turned from red to purple overnight |url=https://blogs.lse.ac.uk/usappblog/2016/09/19/with-evan-bayhs-surprise-entry-indianas-senate-race-has-turned-from-red-to-purple-overnight/ |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=USAPP}}{{Cite web |first1=Jeremy |last1=Silk Smith |date=2016-08-17 |title=Poll: Bayh Holds Significant Lead Over Young in Indiana Senate Race |url=https://rollcall.com/2016/08/17/poll-bayh-holds-significant-lead-over-young-in-indiana-senate-race/ |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=Roll Call |language=en-US}} Bayh, an Indiana political giant, was considered the frontrunner until he faced criticism for many of his post-senatorial activities, allowing Young to gain momentum and secure a decisive victory.{{Cite web |last=Ropeik |first=Annie |date=2016-11-09 |title=In Senate Loss, Bayh Couldn't Overcome Modern Image Among Voters |url=https://www.wfyi.org/news/articles/in-senate-loss-bayh-couldnt-overcome-modern-image-among-voters |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=WFYI Public Media |language=en-us}} In March 2021, Young announced he would seek a second term.{{Cite web |date=2021-03-02 |title=Indiana Sen. Todd Young announces 2022 reelection campaign |url=https://apnews.com/article/donald-trump-technology-todd-young-evan-bayh-indiana-af72ea56ee00a6f517b7ee0e335f2dec |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=AP News |language=en}} Young's main opponent in the election was Thomas McDermott Jr., the longtime mayor of Hammond, Indiana.{{Cite web |last=Lange |first=Kaitlin |title=Hammond Mayor Thomas McDermott Jr. files to run for Sen. Todd Young's seat in 2022 |url=https://www.indystar.com/story/news/politics/2021/08/18/indiana-senate-hammond-mayor-files-sen-young-seat/8186048002/ |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=The Indianapolis Star |language=en-US}} McDermott ran as a moderate, criticizing Young for his ties to the Republican establishment and emphasizing his pro-choice stance in light of the Dobbs v. Jackson Supreme Court decision.{{Cite web |title=Democratic Senate candidate Thomas McDermott talks 'the top issue' — abortion access — and plans if elected |url=https://www.idsnews.com/article/2022/09/democratic-senate-candidate-thomas-mcdermott-abortion-election |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=Democratic Senate candidate Thomas McDermott talks ‘the top issue’ — abortion access — and plans if elected - Indiana Daily Student |language=en-US}} Young, on the other hand, focused on issues like inflation and border security, directing most of his attacks at President Joe Biden rather than McDermott.{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=u_DUPIHhOjs |title=Border Collie {{!}} Todd Young for U.S. Senate |date=2022-01-11 |last=Todd Young |access-date=2024-07-02 |via=YouTube}}{{Cite AV media |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7qeKG867jXI |title=Recapping Joe Biden's Disastrous First Year {{!}} Todd Young for U.S. Senate |date=2022-01-18 |last=Todd Young |access-date=2024-07-02 |via=YouTube}} While early polls indicated a close race,{{Cite web |first1=Abdul |last1=Hakim-Shabazz |title=New Poll Shows Close U.S. Senate Race |url=https://indypolitics.org/new-poll-shows-close-u-s-senate-race/ |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=Indy Politics |language=en-US}} a poll conducted around Election Day showed Young with a comfortable lead.{{Cite web |last=Wiederkehr |first=Ryan Best, Aaron Bycoffe, Ritchie King, Dhrumil Mehta and Anna |date=2018-06-28 |title=Indiana : U.S. Senate : 2022 Polls |url=https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/polls/senate/2022/indiana/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20220915193057/https://projects.fivethirtyeight.com/polls/senate/2022/indiana/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=September 15, 2022 |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=FiveThirtyEight |language=en}} On October 16, three weeks before the election, the only debate was held which featured Young, McDermontt, and Libertarian Nominee James Sceniak. The Debate centered on a number of issues, including The Economy, Immigration/Border security, and Climate change, among others. Young, mainly focused on Immigration, while avoiding attacking his opponents, McDermott attacked Young relentlessly throughout the debate, even stating “When Senator Young supports spending, it is good inflation, but when he doesn't support it, that is bad inflation. The chips act is a spending bill. Todd Young helped to add to our nation inflation problem”.{{Cite web |title=Indiana U.S. Senate Debate {{!}} C-SPAN.org |url=https://www.c-span.org/video/?522701-1/indiana-us-senate-debate |access-date=2024-07-02 |website=www.c-span.org}} Young went on to win the election easily, outperforming his 2016 performance by 11 points and receiving nearly 59% of the vote to McDermott's
